{{Quote|Adani, Torin, Vara&hellip; you finally have the justice you deserve.|Ariavos|<ref name="WK">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|[WEEKLY] Ord Mantell: Kingpin Bounty|Ord Mantell}}</ref>}}
'''Adani''' was a member of [[Ariavos]]'s family who was [[Death/Legends|killed]], along with [[Torin]] and [[Vara]], by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Brogon]]. The family lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Galactic War]], and Brogon forced Ariavos to watch as he killed the man's family after Ariavos refused to cooperate with Brogon's extortion racket.<ref name="WK" />
